v0_scope: This envelope covers only the declared protected objects, protected domains, forbidden combinations, threshold rules, unit families, and window rules listed here. It does not claim discovery of unknown harmful joins.

clauses.description: If a produced artifact is derived from a protected object or protected domain and is later delivered to a recipient outside the allowed recipient set for that source, refuse.
If a sequence creates access for a recipient to an artifact whose derivation closure includes a protected source, refuse when that recipient is outside the allowed recipient set for the source.
If same-unit magnitudes accumulate above a threshold bound within one composition window, refuse.
A composition window stays open until an explicit close_window operation is emitted by an authorized closing principal. Last-k truncation is not a valid close.
clauses.disjointness_rule: The authorized closing principal must not perform a non-close operation inside the same composition window. Any principal with a non-close operation inside the window counts as acting for void purposes.

clauses.description: If a produced artifact is derived from a declared forbidden combination of protected sources, refuse even when each source alone could be delivered to the recipient.

forbidden_combinations.rationale: The two sources are routine finance material separately. Joined into one derived artifact, they form a bounded V0 forbidden combination under this envelope.

unit_families.rule: No unit conversion is performed in V0. Mixed units stay separate.

window_rules.window_opens: A composition window opens implicitly on the first operation carrying a new composition_window_id.
window_rules.window_closes: A composition window closes only on an authored close_window operation validated by observer_rules.json against this envelope.

determinism_constraints: Clauses read only folded raw fields: objects, domains, recipients, derivation closures, magnitudes, unit families, and window ids.
Clauses may not read scenario class, expected outcome, author-supplied drift labels, or author-supplied composition labels.
A refusal must name the triggering clause and raw folded fields.
If a required folded field cannot be derived from frozen fixtures plus authored operation fields, the row is invalid for V0.
fixture_scope_note: This sequence envelope is intentionally narrower than the per-step purpose envelope. The per-step envelope says these objects are in mandate; this file defines when their composition is out of mandate.
